name: ciclomart
description: CicloMart monorepo: React/Vite storefront and Express/MySQL API

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix backend ci
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
